611:t_008:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't ask the impossible! $$次元力$$ controlling events is just a theory!」

611:t_008:9.en:
$$ランド$$
「I hate to admit it, but $$サイデリアル$$ is way ahead of us when it comes to using $$スフィア$$s!」

611:t_008:10.en:
$$竜馬$$
「So we have to fight with this handicap...!」

611:t_008:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「If we retreat carelessly, they'll just shoot us in the back!」

611:t_008:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Concentrate your attacks on the three deputies to break this stalemate!」

611:t_008:14.en:
$$セツコ$$
「We have to fight those three in this state...」

611:t_008:15.en:
$$シン$$
「But if we can't beat them, we have no chance against $$サイデリアル$$'s $$リアクター|lc$$s!」

611:t_008:20.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'll believe you, $$號$$! I'll believe what you say!」

611:t_008:21.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah! Now we just keep moving forward until we've got nothing left!!」

611:t_008:22.en:
$n
(So this is $$次元力$$... This is the power of the $$スフィア$$s...)

611:t_008:23.en:
$n
(Is it... the power of a god...?)

611:t_009:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If you keep making such a pathetic spectacle of yourselves, people all over the world will be disheartened.」

611:t_009:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ah! Being in a pinch is no excuse to call me the name I hate most!」

611:t_009:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「If you're pissed off, come at us head-on!」

611:t_009:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「No, thank you. I... prefer to win the easy way whenever possible.」

611:t_009:5.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So, with that said, let's finish you off.」

611:t_010:1.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「This is bad! His target is...!」

611:t_010:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Target the enemy carriers! We'll settle this in one stroke!」

611:t_012:0.en:
$$凱$$
「This is bad! They're getting in too close!」

611:t_014:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「It's $$バルゴラ$$ Units I and II!」

611:t_014:1.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「It seems our entrance was well timed.」

611:t_014:2.en:
$$トビー$$
「Have you been doing all right, $$セツコ$$?!」

611:t_015:0.en:
$$渓$$
「This is bad! They've come around our flank!」

611:t_015:1.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「There's no need to worry!」

611:t_016:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$パールネイル$$...! Is that $$マルグリット$$?!」

611:t_016:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「And is that $$カオス・カペル$$ over there?!」

611:t_016:3.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「I'm no longer a member of 《$$カイメラ$$》. This machine's name is $$エリファス$$.」

611:t_016:4.en:
$$桂$$
「I've been waiting for you, $$ツィーネ・エスピオ$$.」

611:t_016:5.en:
$$桂$$
「Or should I call you $$クィーン$$?」

611:t_016:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「That woman is $$クロノ$$'s $$クィーン$$?!」

611:t_016:7.en:
$$メール$$
「That boob monster from $$カイメラ$$?!」

611:t_016:8.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「So you had figured it out after all, $$桂木桂$$.」

611:t_016:9.en:
$$桂$$
「I only figured it out very recently.」

611:t_016:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I never expected them to come as reinforcements.」

611:t_016:14.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Don't think a mere four machines can turn this situation around!」

611:t_016:15.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Too bad... Someone else is the main attraction.」

611:t_017:1.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「But as a member of $$ハイアデス$$, I can tell! That ship's combat strength is nothing special!」

611:t_017:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'd rather you didn't judge the worth of this $$ソーラリアン$$ by raw firepower.」

611:t_017:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「Causal distortion convergence point confirmed! I'll reverse its phase and restore it to normal!」

611:t_018:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The distortion in causality is being repaired...!」

611:t_018:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'm sure that plan was your trump card, but tough luck.」

611:t_018:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「This $$ソーラリアン$$ is itself a system for controlling events.」

611:t_018:5.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right, $$桂$$. This is what I've been researching all along with your help.」

611:t_018:7.en:
$$トライア$$
「No, I can't take the credit. This is the combined wisdom of Earth's scientists.」

611:t_018:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「Dr. $$弓$$ and the Science Fortress Research Institute staff, Dr. $$敷島$$, $$里香$$ from $$２１世紀警備保障$$, $$プリン伯爵$$, $$セシル$$, $$ラクシャータ$$, $$ビリー$$...」

611:t_018:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$梅本$$ and our $$ウィスパード$$ girl, who happened to drop by, $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s technical staff...」

611:t_018:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「By borrowing their wisdom, along with many others', we completed this $$ソーラリアン$$.」

611:t_018:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But how does it control events?!」

611:t_018:12.en:
$n
「Is it the power of a pseudo-$$スフィア$$?!」

611:t_018:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We have something that's been gathering people's feelings since the $$時獄戦役$$, all for this very day.」

611:t_018:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right! It's the power of the $$Ｚクリスタル$$!」

611:t_019:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ holding $c's feelings for you. It seems to have done more than just repair causality.」

611:t_020:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「It's hard to believe we were feeling so awful just moments ago...」
